verdicts.reason: A keeps the original layout intact: both owls hang from the edges as they should, the centred eyebrow and two-line headline stay clean, and only a little extra empty space opens up below. B makes the headline far too big, so the confetti, stars and red flag run through 'DIRTHDAY' and 'PARTIES'; it moves 'EVENT MANAGMENT' to the top-left, jammed against the edge, a squiggle and the owl; it cuts the hanging owl loose from the top edge; and it shrinks the right owl until it floats awkwardly.
